narratives.body: City Wire reports that Cedar United goalkeeper Kim Park will miss the next match with an ankle injury, though no return date was given. City Wire also reports that Cedar United appointed Jo Vale as head coach on Monday, with a contract lasting two years. Additionally, City Wire reports that Cedar United won 2–1 against Vale City on Sunday.
narratives.headline: Cedar United update: Kim Park injury, Jo Vale appointment, and 2-1 victory
